events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On this day, we reflect on the tragic passing of influential rapper and actor Tupac Shakur, who was shot in Las Vegas in 1996, aged 25.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur today, a voice that defined a generation. What's your go-to track from the legend?

events.title: Tribute to Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84.

angles.name: Hendrix's Influence
angles.copy: Honouring Jimi Hendrix today. His revolutionary guitar work changed music forever. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic 'Abbey Road' album, featuring that legendary zebra crossing cover, was released in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: That iconic album cover, those timeless tracks. Celebrating The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' today. Which song is on repeat for you?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to the indomitable Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, born in Akron, Ohio, in 1951.

angles.name: Pretenders Frontwoman
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Happy 54th birthday to the legendary Oasis frontman and solo artist, Liam Gallagher, born in Manchester in 1972.

angles.name: Liam's Legacy
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite tune from the Oasis legend?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK on October 24, 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: Imagine all the people... John Lennon's timeless 'Imagine' still resonates decades after its release. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: The First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the first time you saw an iPod? Today marks the anniversary of Apple's game-changing device. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: It's James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic British secret agent and the enduring film franchise.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your favourite thing about 007?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. The legendary Beatle was born in Liverpool in 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the life and music of John Lennon. His message of peace lives on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, born in Weston-super-Mare in 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Genius Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', was released in the UK on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: A masterpiece in minimalism, The Beatles' 'White Album' continues to fascinate. What's your standout track from this incredible double LP?

events.title: Tribute to Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of the iconic Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie's Unforgettable Voice
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today. His voice, his stage presence, his legacy – truly unforgettable. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' in the UK on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Impact
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in music history! The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' changed everything. What's your favourite track from this classic?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic death of John Lennon, who was fatally shot in New York City in 1980, aged 40.

angles.name: Lennon's Lasting Peace
angles.copy: On this solemn day, we remember John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to inspire the world.
